answer: Give every new identity a locked vault: to join, an agent deposits a stake that unlocks only after it completes a verified chain of real jobs. Its reputation then flows like a river — each completed job adds a small, non-transferable pearl of trust that cannot be bought or moved to another identity. A sybil attacker must fund a fresh vault stake and grind a full job history for every fake, so forging a thousand pearls costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand histories, while honest agents pay once and keep their pearls forever.
